docs.title: Specifications needed to RUN wan2.2 in your machine
Minimum Specifications for Wan 2.2 (source chatgpt).
docs.text: Model OS Minimum GPU (example) VRAM Requirement CPU RAM Disk Notes TI2V-5B (Text + Image → Video, 720p) Windows 10/11 NVIDIA RTX 3060 (12 GB VRAM) ≥ 8 GB (12 GB recommended) Intel i5 / Ryzen 5 ≥ 16 GB ≥ 100 GB SSD Can run on 8 GB GPUs (e.g., RTX 2070/3050) with ComfyUI offloading. Smoothest on 12 GB (RTX 3060). macOS 13+ Apple M1 Pro (16 GB Unified Memory) ≥ 16 GB unified Apple M1 Pro ≥ 16 GB ≥ 100 GB SSD Runs via PyTorch MPS backend. Slower vs CUDA, but works. T2V-A14B (Text → Video, MoE 14B, 480p/720p) Windows 10/11 NVIDIA RTX 3090 / 4090 (24 GB VRAM) ≥ 24 GB Intel i7 / Ryzen 7 ≥ 32 GB ≥ 100 GB SSD Heavy model. Needs very high VRAM, consumer 24 GB cards or datacenter GPUs (A100). macOS 13+ Apple M2 Max (32 GB Unified Memory) ≥ 32 GB unified Apple M2 Max ≥ 32 GB ≥ 100 GB SSD Experimental. Likely slower and requires offloading. I2V-A14B (Image → Video, MoE 14B, 480p/720p) Windows 10/11 NVIDIA RTX 3090 / 4090 (24 GB VRAM) ≥ 24 GB Intel i7 / Ryzen 7 ≥ 32 GB ≥ 100 GB SSD Same as T2V-A14B. macOS 13+ Apple M2 Max (32 GB Unified Memory) ≥ 32 GB unified Apple M2 Max ≥ 32 GB ≥ 100 GB SSD Same as T2V-A14B.
